=== transcribe.sh: how it uses ffmpeg ===
48:  Via ffmpeg: mp4, m4a, aac, webm, mkv, avi, mov, wma, opus, aiff, amr,
76:# whisper-cli handles these natively (no ffmpeg conversion needed)
79:# Everything else is converted via ffmpeg to 16 kHz mono WAV
152:for f in /opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg /usr/local/bin/ffmpeg ffmpeg; do
156:    warn "ffmpeg not found — only native formats (flac, mp3, ogg, wav) will be supported."
166:    # Returns: native, ffmpeg, or empty string (unsupported)
175:            *" $e "*) echo ffmpeg; return ;;
284:    if [[ "$(ext_type "$ext")" == "ffmpeg" ]]; then
286:        log "  Converting via ffmpeg → WAV 16 kHz mono…"
292:            err "  ffmpeg conversion failed — skipping."
